caption:
Daru Dictionary, No. 02: four tasting words. 🥃

Dram, nose, finish, cask strength. Next time someone at the party says “notes of oak”, you’ll know what they mean.

Which word did you just learn? Comment below, and save this for your next tasting.

Water between pegs. Never drink and drive.
